Daily Quiz.question: ১) Choose the correct sentence -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I care not a straw for him.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I do not care a straw for him.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I not care a straw for him.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I care a straw for him.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Negative Assertive বাক্যের গঠন -Subject+do/does not+verb এর base form.
সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর I do not care a straw for him.
উল্লেখ্য, বাক্যের বিদ্যমান not care a straw একটি phrase. তাই বাক্যটি স্বাভাবিক ভাবে বাক্যটি Negative হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Which of the following is an example of active and present indefinite tense?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is writing a letter.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I have invited them.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He has done the work.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Floods destroy crops.
Daily Quiz.exp: Subject + মূল verb এর present form...

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Choose the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I asked Rony had he passed
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I asked Rony if he had passed
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I asked Rony if you had passed
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I asked Rony that had he passed
Daily Quiz.exp: Interrogative sentence-এর direct narration-কে indirect narration-এ পরিবর্তন করার সময় reported speech-এর পূর্বে if বা whether বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Which one is a correct sentence?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I found his pulse
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I felt his pulse
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I examined his pulse
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I saw his pulse
Daily Quiz.exp: Feel somebody’s pulse অর্থ হাতের কবজির ধমনিতে হাত রেখে নাড়িস্পন্দনের হার গণনা করা।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Choose the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Repeat it again
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Repeat it
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Repeats it again
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Repeat it against
Daily Quiz.exp: সঠিক বাক্য হলো repeat it কেননা repeat অর্থ পুনরায় বলা বা করা সুতরাং এর সাথে again ব্যবহার সঠিক নয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Which one is correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Sundarban
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The sundarbans
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The sundarban
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Sundarbans
Daily Quiz.exp: সঠিক option টি হলো the sundarbans কেননা এটি plural হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং এর পূর্বে the article ব্যবহৃত হয় ।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Choose the correct one:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is caught of flattery
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He is ill of flattery
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He is sick of flattery
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He is angry of flattery
Daily Quiz.exp: He is sick of flattery- সে তোষামদ প্রিয় ।

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Write down the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Tell me why have you come here?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) What time did you go to bed last night?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Why you are angry with me?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) When you passed your Diploma Examination?
Daily Quiz.exp: Last night সময় নির্দেশক adverb যা বাক্যে past indefinite tense নির্দেশ করে। Past indefinite tense এর সঠিক interrogative বাক্য What time did you go to bed last night?

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) The mother would not eat until she had feed all her children.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) replace unit with any
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) replace eat with ate
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) replace feed with fed
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) replace would with will
Daily Quiz.exp: Until-এর পরের clause এ had+verb এর p.p থাকার কথা থাকলেও verb এর present from ব্যাবহার করা হয়েছে। সুতরাং feed এর স্থলে feed এর p.p fed বসালে বাক্যটি সটিক হবে ।

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Which sentence is correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The girl burst out of tears
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The girl burst into tears
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The girl burst out with tears
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The girl burst out through tears
Daily Quiz.exp: Burst into tears- কান্নায় ভেঙে পড়া।

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Which of the following is correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Sophocles tragedies are famous
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Sophocles’ tragedies are famous
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Sophocles’s tragedies are famous
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The Sophocles tragedy is famous
Daily Quiz.exp: প্রদও চারটি options-এর মধ্যে (গ) Sophocles’s tragedies are famous বাক্যটিই সঠিক । শব্দের শেষে ‘es’ থাকায় ‘s যোগ করে possessive form হয়েছে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) The correct sentence is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The girl laughed and entered the room.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The girl entered the room laughing.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The girl laughed entering the room.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The girl laughingly entered the room.
Daily Quiz.exp: সঠিক বাক্য হলো The girl entered the room laughing যার অর্থ মেয়েটি হাসতে হাসতে কক্ষে প্রবেশ করলো ।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Choose the correct sentence-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I wish I were them!
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I wish I were he!
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I wish I were his!
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I wish I were him!
Daily Quiz.exp: Be verb (were) -এর পর pronoun-এর subjective from (he) বসবে। কখনো objective বা possessive form নয় । সুতরাং I wish I were he! হলো সঠিক বাক্য।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) The future of the planet doesn't look too good, but there isn’t much __
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I can make about it
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I can do about it
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) can I do about it
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I can’t do about it
Daily Quiz.exp: Do about something অর্থ কোনো কিছুর সাথে পেরে উঠার জন্য পদক্ষেপ নেয়া । আর but- এর পর negative বাক্য থাকার এর পরের অংশটি positive statement হবে । সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর “I can do about it”.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Which one is correct?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He brought two pairs of shoes.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He has brought two pairs of shoes.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He brought two pair of shoes.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) All the above.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Pair এর plural form pair এবং pairs দুটিই।
Examples -
- a pair of gloves/shoes
- a pair of pants/scissors
- Each package contains three pairs of socks.
Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Select the correct sentence:
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) His information is false.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) His informations are false.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) His information are false.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) His informations are true.
Daily Quiz.exp: Information একটি abstract noun এর পর verb এর singular form হয়। সুতরাং (ক) option-এর বাক্যটি সঠিক।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Choose the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) We have many works to do in summer
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) We have much works to do in summer
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) We have a lot of work to do in summer
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) We have lot of works to do in summer
Daily Quiz.exp: Work একটি uncountable noun তাই s হবে না। সুতরাং( ক ), ( খ ) ও ( ঘ) উত্তর গুলো ভুল।সঠিক উত্তর (গ) কারণ a lot of এমন একটি determiner যা countable ও uncountable উভয় noun-এর পূর্বে বসতে পারে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Choose the correct sentence-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I have a little friends in bangladesh
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I have little friends in bangladesh
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I have few friend in bangladesh
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I have a few friends in bangladesh
Daily Quiz.exp: Friends শব্দটি countable ও plural noun এবং বাক্যটি ইতিবাচক হওয়ায় I have a few friends বাক্যটি সঠিক।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Choose the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Less people get American Visas nowadays
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Least people get American Visas nowadays
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Few people get American Visas nowadays
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Fewer people get American Visas nowadays
Daily Quiz.exp: Little এর comparative degree হচ্ছে less এবং few এর comparative degree fewer. Uncountable noun এর আগে less এবং countable এর আগে fewer বসে ‘তুলনামূলক কম’ অর্থ প্রদান করে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Find the correct sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The intruder stood quietly for few moments.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The intruder stood quietly for few time.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) The intruder stood quietly for sometimes.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The intruder stood quietly for a few moments.
Daily Quiz.exp: Some moments(কিছু মুহূর্ত/সময় ) বুঝাতে a few moments ব্যবহৃত হয়।
